payload.prompt: What does a soda-straw camera record at its output?
choices: A full 2D image of the scene
A 1D signal — the light intensity along a single direction over time
A depth map of the scene
payload.explanation_correct: Right — the straw passes only one direction of light, so the output is a single scalar intensity per moment. You'd have to scan it to build an image.
payload.explanation_wrong: A straw is narrow enough to admit essentially one direction. With only one direction reaching the sensor, you can't form a 2D image at one instant.
